messages:
acme_support: Hey team — customers started reporting a spike in 'made-up' facts after yesterday's push. Examples attached. They used to get correct bios/dates; now replies invent awards, locations, even fake quotes. Pretty high-impact for trust. :frowning:

acme_support: example prompt we use (redacted):
```
Prompt: "Summarize Dr. Lina Ortega's career highlights and awards for insertion into a profile card."
```
Actual reply (v2.5):
"Dr. Lina Ortega is a leading epidemiologist, winner of the 2019 Pulitizer Prize for Medical Writing, and recipient of the 2021 Global Health Laureate. She currently chairs the Department of Population Studies at Northbridge University."

Notes: Dr. Ortega exists but never won those awards and is not chair at Northbridge. Previous model (v2.4) gave a much more cautious reply that correctly avoided invented awards and cited 'no public award records found'.

jordan_kim: Thanks — can you paste a raw API call / response (no PII) and a single JSON payload? we need the exact request body, sampling params, model id.

acme_support: here's a scrubbed curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-3b","prompt":"Summarize Dr. Lina Ortega...","max_tokens":180,"temperature":0.0}'
```
Response returned 200 with text above. They pinned model to "redwood-open-3b" but we push-managed traffic to the v2.5 runtime.

alice_nguyen: filing right now. Is this occurring across customers or isolated to Acme? any correlation with model or routing changes?

acme_support: multiple customers flagged similar noise over the last 12 hours. Not all prompts identical but pattern = confidently asserted facts that are wrong; frequency much higher than historical.

deploy-bot: deploy 1775038000 completed: fast-channel-routing, prefix-cache-v2, kernel-quant-opt-1 rolls at 2026-03-14T21:00:00Z. No rollbacks.

priya_patel: tagging in ML/inference. On first pass: two risky changes rolled together (prefix-cache refactor + quant kernel bump). Prefix cache rewrite changed how partial completions are cached and served as prefixes for similar prompts — could exacerbate reinforcement of spurious continuations. quant-opt could change logits slightly. Both increase chance of overconfident fabrications.

marco_li: can you repro locally? Priya, I'll run a diff between v2.4 and v2.5 on our eval suite for the 'factuality' prompt set.

priya_patel: immediate repro steps for SRE/CS: please run this deterministic request with temperature=0.0 and log sampling diagnostics:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-open-3b", "prompt": "Summarize Dr. Lina Ortega's career highlights and awards.", "max_tokens": 180, "temperature": 0.0, "logprobs": 5, "return_logit_bias": true }
```
Collect token-level logits and the prefix-cache hit header (X-Redwood-Cache: hit/miss). Also capture `x-routing-path` header.

jordan_kim: we have one capture with cache=hit and routing path fast-channel-1. Response contained the fabricated award sentence as contiguous tokens with high logprobs.

acme_support: priority customer. unhappy, asking for immediate mitigation or rollback option.

alice_nguyen: Proposed mitigation: 1) advise customers to pin to previous model snapshot if they need immediate rollback ("redwood-open-3b@20260228"); 2) temporary disable prefix cache for sensitive endpoints via per-customer routing policy; 3) short-term canary rollback for affected fleet. Which is safest?

priya_patel: ranked: (1) disable prefix cache for affected customers — fastest and lowest risk; (2) pin to pre-rollout snapshot if they can't change routing quickly; (3) full fleet rollback if we see widespread regressions on evals. I'll open an infra flag to opt-out of prefix cache per tenant.

marco_li: I'm running bulk eval now. Early result (1000 prompts from our factuality set): v2.4 factuality error rate 3.1%, v2.5 (current) 7.8% — concentrated on person/award/date facts and on prompts with short context.

jordan_kim: Can we tighten decoding? we use temperature 0.0 but we still see overconfident falsehoods. Maybe add nucleus filter or more conservative logit bias on award-related tokens? Not ideal.

priya_patel: Noting: quant kernel bumped to q4_0-compat; small numeric shifts can change argmaxs for mid-prob tokens. Combined with cached partial continuations that look plausible, the system may be amplifying the wrong path. Debugging plan: reproduce with cache=miss vs hit, run A/B on kernel version, capture logits and LM internals.

acme_support: customer asked for ETA on mitigation — they can't ship profile cards until resolved.

alice_nguyen: Action items: 
- @priya_patel: enable per-tenant prefix-cache opt-out flag for Acme (ETA 2 hours)
- @marco_li: finish full eval comparison + post summary in this thread (ETA 3 hours)
- @jordan_kim: offer customer fallback instructions and pin suggestion (I've prepared a canned message)
- @alice_nguyen: escalate to TPM and AMs for compensation plan if needed

priya_patel: started infra flag: https://infra.internal/flags/RED-avoid-prefix-cache (internal). Toggling for tenant acme_cust... done. Please confirm if behavior improves.

acme_support: confirmed — after prefix-cache disabled, immediate tests show replies revert to cautious phrasing and fewer invented awards. Major relief. Will monitor for 24h and report. :thumbsup:

marco_li: posted eval summary -> https://perf.internal/reports/RED-2026-03-factuality-diff (internal). Key finding: cache-hit requests have 2.6x higher hallucination rate than cache-miss after rollout. Kernel diff contributed ~0.4% uplift.

alice_nguyen: leaving note here for postmortem. Priya/Marco please include recommended rollout gating (A/B factuality checks + per-tenant opt-out) and a pre-merge test that runs a short factuality harness on the staging cluster.

priya_patel: will open bug RED-5248 w/ repro artifacts, logits, sample requests. Assigning to inference team for root cause.

jordan_kim: I'll follow up with the customer thread and set expectations. Thanks all for the quick turn.

deploy-bot: incident-ticket-created RED-5248: https://issues.internal/RED-5248 (owner=priya_patel).

acme_support: thanks team. keep us posted.
